Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Sivam Raturi, learned counsel
holding brief of Mr. Shailendra Nauriyal,
learned counsel for applicant.
2. Mr. Bhaskar Chandra Joshi, learned
A.G.A. with and Ms. Sweta Dobhal, learned
Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. From perusal of the record, it
transpires that the present C482
application was filed on 14.04.2024 and
the defects was reported by the Registry
on 22.04.2024.
4. Since, several opportunities were
given to applicant to remove the defects
vide orders dated 01.05.2024, 09.05.2024
and 22.05.2024, but the defects have not
been removed by the applicant. This Court
again vide order dated 10.03.2025,
granted 10 days' time to applicant to
remove the defects, but, no defects have
been removed by the applicant.
5. Accordingly, the present C482
application is dismissed for non-compliance
of the order passed by this Court.
